oneClickRef: Reference child documents in all documents
oneClickCheck: Check child document references in all documents
noChildren: No documents with child documents in the workspace
noTable: No child reference table found in the workspace; run "Reference" first
hint: "Reference all" only fixes documents with missing or invalid references; "Check all" is read-only.
confirmRef: This will scan ${count} document(s) and only fix those with missing or invalid references (add missing, remove invalid); other documents are left untouched. Continue?
confirmClear: This will delete ${count} invalid reference(s) from the tables. Continue?
confirmFill: This will add the missing child references in ${count} document(s). Continue?
allUpToDate: No missing or invalid references found; nothing to do
cleared: ${count} invalid reference(s) cleared; re-checked results below.
notChild: Target is not a direct child of this document
